Workforce Scenario Planner

Strategic workforce & succession planning prototype · quarterly Monte Carlo over a synthetic workforce mirroring UIUC's published Fall 2023 IPEDS staff headcount (12,905). Five-year horizon, P10/P50/P90 bands.

Synthetic population calibrated to public aggregates. Not a prediction about UIUC staff. No real employee record was used. Calibration targets are IPEDS (UIUC, Fall 2023) and Census QWI (all Illinois NAICS 6113 employers). Levels, tenure, critical-role flags, promotion and time-to-fill rates are labelled assumptions. Outputs are aggregate; nothing here scores an individual. The AI lever is your assumption, not an estimate.

Total headcount

P10–P90Scenario P50No-lever baseline P50

Persons in primary appointments. Promotions and transfers are internal moves and never change this count. The saw-tooth is calibrated seasonality: QWI separations peak in calendar Q2.

P10–P90Scenario P50Baseline P50

Families are IPEDS occupation categories. Small families have wide relative bands.

Critical-role vacancy share

P10–P90Scenario P50Baseline P50

Share of authorized critical positions vacant at quarter end (aggregate). Critical = illustrative rule (FT staff level 4; level 3 in CES and HLT). Freezes exempt critical roles. Q+0 vacancies are synthetic placements; the first quarters show the model settling.

Bench strength: ready-now candidates per critical role

P10–P90Scenario P50Baseline P50

Pooled by family × level: FT incumbents one level below, ≥8 quarters in level, not retirement-eligible. A count of a pool, not a ranking of people. Covered share (pool ≥ roles) is listed in the KPI tiles.

Knowledge-loss exposure

P10–P90Scenario P50Baseline P50

Cumulative share of the Fall-2023 stock of service-years held by people who have since separated (tenure-weighted). Service years are synthetic.

Capacity-equivalent FTE vs Fall-2023 FTE

P10–P90Scenario P50Baseline, 0% uplift

FTE × (1 + your uplift) on the selected families, minus Fall-2023 FTE. A what-if multiplier on capacity: it does not change headcount, is not derived from any productivity evidence and must not be read as a staffing reduction target.

Job families at horizon

Cumulative flows (P50 of runs)

P50 of each cumulative flow separately; P50s are not additive. Retirements = separations of people meeting an illustrative eligibility rule (age ≥ 60 with ≥ 10 years, or age ≥ 55 with ≥ 30 years), not SURS rules. Blocked promotions: a ready candidate was selected by the transition matrix but no vacant higher-level line existed.
